verdict.tagline: Classic lane defense strategy, hampered by rigid display limitations.
for_you_if: you love timeless lawn defense puzzles
you want addictive casual strategy action
not_for_you_if: you require native widescreen display support
you cannot play games in windowed mode

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: Early buyers immediately embrace the accessible planting action.

cohorts.label: 2-20h
cohorts.summary: Players experience display failures in fullscreen requiring windowed mode.

claims.claim: Reviewers experience display issues, severe black screens, and messed up textures when attempting to play in fullscreen mode due to the forced 800x600 resolution, requiring windowed mode to run stably.

citations.review_text: Deserves all of its praise, loved it when i was younger still love it now. Only issue is that playing in window mode is required, as playing fullscreen messes up the textures, which is annoying. If only there was an HD remaster, sadly one never came out.

# Doesn't scale to modern displays.

Switching to fullscreen triggers severe black screens and display loops because of the forced 800x600 resolution. The only stable way to play is in windowed mode scaled with Windows Magnifier. Just buy Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted if you want native widescreen without the hassle.

Great game!
I get this glitch that makes window sizes weird, but asides from that it's a great remaster from the original game, would recommend to anyone who hasn't played the original pvz in a long time!

cohorts.label: 20-100h
cohorts.summary: Experienced players encounter strict resolution limits and monitor display crashes.

claims.claim: The game only runs at a 4:3 aspect ratio and 800x600 resolution on PC.

citations.review_text:
I would still suggest this game if Steam was still compatible with Windows 7 or lower, but since it isn't this game requires a mod to function properly. I would highly suggest buying the remaster instead. I still enjoyed this game a lot, but I prefer controller, and the remaster has high quality animations and textures. 

This game only plays at 4:3 aspect ration and 800x600p. Get the remaster instead. Still a great game!!!

Truly a classic. However, there are some differences between PC and Mobile:
PC:
+Has Tree of Wisdom
+Customizable zombies
+Coffee Beans only placeable on tired plants
+No ads
+Music video ending 
+No "Lucky Spin" achievement
+Dynamic Music
-No offline zen garden 
-No purchasable surprise boxes
-Can't select specific stages
-No dig to China achievement and record
-Unable to sell plants in "Last Stand"
-Locked in Adventure 2 mode beating Adventure 1
-Older art and designs

Mobile:
+Offline Zen garden
+Purchasable surprise boxes
+Stage select screen
+Dig to China achievement and record
+Able to sell undamaged plans in "Last Stand"
+Able to return to Adventure 1 anytime
+Newer art and designs
-Ads
-No Tree of Wisdom
-No Customizable Zombies
-Coffee Beans Placeable on ANY plant
-Bland Ending
-"Lucky Spin" achievement based entirely on RNG
-HORRENDOUS more recent update by EA

claims.claim: Reviewers report technical issues where opening the game causes monitor crashes or screen flickering between black and the game window.

citations.review_text: it was very fun, very very fun, and then it started crashing my monitor any time i opened it which makes me sad i can't play it

This has been a fantastic way to play classic PVZ for years at this point, but I can't recommend it right now because every time I open the game, the screen flickers between black and showing the game. It does it a *lot*. I've tried redownloading the game, verifying files, adjusting settings, nothings worked, when it was working fine on my computer a couple weeks ago, and I haven't even had a windows update since. EA if this is your attempt to get us to buy Replanted, its not working on me :/
